objective: Compare per-pixel alpha association response of registered Film Grunge grain and Film Damage scratch/dust overlay source equations on a shared synthetic translucent edge.

effects: Film Grunge: controlled grain-only source equation, grainAmount .075, grainSize 1.4, seed 1977, frame 0; all other controls neutral.

Film Damage: controlled scratch/dust overlay-only pixel equation using fixed diagnostic overlay colors/alpha; grain, weave, flicker, and burn are zero. Overlay locations are fixture-defined, not source RNG parity.
scope.method: Independent NumPy/OpenCV equation model. Compare each same source with effect-off baseline under straight and premultiplied input conventions and black, gray, white backgrounds.
excluded: C++ random placement or compiler signed-overflow behavior
actual alpha descriptor selected by renderer

comparison.baseline: Same alpha/color plate, effect contribution zero, then composite with matching straight or premultiplied equation.
candidates: Film Grunge additive RGB grain residual.
comparison.ground_truth: None; paired effect-off source only separates model response, not quality.
comparison.acceptance: Report model response and alpha/association invariants descriptively. No product defect declaration or effect ranking.

materials.source: Generated 256x128 smooth ellipse alpha edge with fixed foreground color; fixed line/circle damage overlay authored by the script.
materials.storage: Logical RGB color is explicitly stored as physical BGRA; scalar backgrounds are channel symmetric.

conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 normalized direct values; no transfer conversion or HDR transform.
conditions.alpha: Each branch keeps source alpha. Straight composite = rgb*alpha+background*(1-alpha). Premultiplied composite = rgb+background*(1-alpha).
conditions.metrics: Stored RGB effect residual and composite MAE/RMS/max per alpha region; alpha identity; premultiplied RGB bound violations in this bounded [0,1] fixture; fixed display contact sheets.
conditions.display: Diagnostic RGB8 clips [0,1] and directly quantizes; raw float metrics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Check source markers, deterministic fixed fixture, exact per-pixel formula, alpha passthrough, and paired baseline composite equations.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Formula model within float32 tolerance; no image-quality gate.

image_quality_and_detail.judge: Research author inspects same-scale contact sheets.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic pass/fail; this study only compares alpha response.

color_and_alpha.method: Compare association-correct source-over composites over three backgrounds and bounded premultiplication constraints.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual descriptor/value association and downstream compositing path.

render_paths_and_resolution.reason: No registered effect invocation or resolution sweep.

execution.thresholds: No perceptual thresholds. Require alpha identity, finite outputs, repeatability, and formula agreement within float32 tolerance.
execution.reproducibility: Record plan/source/script/helper hashes, package versions, condition data, report and checksum.
